items.question: Professional Liability / E&O Requirement: Please confirm whether Professional Liability and/or Errors & Omissions coverage is required for vendors providing only custodial/janitorial services under RFP 27-007, and if so, confirm the required limits.

Sexual Abuse & Molestation Coverage: Please confirm whether the Sexual Abuse & Molestation endorsement is required for all custodial personnel, only personnel expected to have direct student contact, or only specific assignments such as day porter services.
Controlling Insurance Requirements: If the insurance limits or requirements in the RFP differ from the separate Insurance Requirements document, which document controls for this solicitation?
Walk Through: Will a site visits be scheduled prior to the proposal deadline?
Schools List: Do you have a Master site list along with square footage of each building?
Contract award structure:: “Does the District intend to award the entire district-wide portfolio to one contractor, or may awards be made by facility, group, region, or other portion of the scope?”
Trash liners: “Please provide historical annual usage or estimated quantities and sizes of trash liners required across the District.”

Chemicals and dispensers: “Please provide the approved cleaning chemical/product list and identify the manufacturer/model of existing soap dispensers so proposers can accurately price compatible soap.”

Equipment Usage: “Please provide an inventory of District-owned custodial equipment that will be available to the successful contractor at elementary schools, including equipment type, quantity, condition, and location.”
Current staff: “Is the successful contractor expected or encouraged to offer employment to incumbent custodial employees currently performing these services?

Prevailing wage: “Are contractors performing services under RFP 27-007 subject to any District, local, state, or federal prevailing wage, living wage, minimum compensation, or fringe-benefit requirements? If so, please provide the applicable wage determination or schedule.”
Day porters: “Which facilities require dedicated day porter coverage, and what are the required days and hours of coverage?”
Current labor hours: “Please provide the current or historical weekly custodial labor hours by facility, if available.”
Current Staffing: “Please provide the current custodial staffing level by facility, including day porters, evening custodians, leads, supervisors, and floor technicians, if available.”
Link for Site Walk: The link does not populate to RSVP for the site walk
Fixture count: Can you provide the # of restrooms and fixture counts per facility?
Site Tour Confirmation: Can the district confirm the details of a site tour the week of October 12th?
AFSCME Transition: What is the District's intended employment/transition approach for current CCSD custodial employees represented by AFSCME Local 1605 as the new contract begins July 1, 2027?
CCSD Owned Equipment: Can the District identify District-owned custodial equipment by site, including age, condition and whether awarded contractor may use it through the entire contract?
Professional Liability: Please clarify whether the Professional Liability $3M/$3M+ and E&O $1M/$2M provisions apply to this custodial contract, and which post-completion coverage period governs.
APPA/Inspection Scores: Can the District provide historical APPA/morning-inspection scores, complaint volumes and service-request volumes by facility for at least the most recent 12 months?
Service Credits: Please define any financial service-credit formula tied to failed SLAs or inspection thresholds.
Required Day Porter Clarity: Can the District identify required occupied-hour day porter staffing windows by site, including breakfast, lunch, athletics and evening/community-use periods.
CMMS Platform: What CMMS platform is used, what interfaces/access will the contractor receive, and are there integration/API or licensing costs?
Pools, High Windows, Skylight Conditions: Please identify all swimming pools, high-window/skylight conditions and specialty floor systems included in the contract.
Portfolio Additions/Deletions: How should suppliers price portfolio additions/deletions during the term: fixed $/SF, negotiated change order, or another unit-rate methodology?
Flooring Types: Schools generally have multiple flooring types (carpet, LVT, concrete etc). Can you provide the sq ft by flooring type by facility?
Technology Integration: Does the District expects direct integration with existing facilities management or work-order software and, if so, which platforms it uses.
Union Seniority List: Can the District provide the seniority list of staff, their original start date and level of pay?
Service days per year: In light of the school calendar provided, what is the minimum of days per year that the district would " require" full custodial/janitorial services?

Award of properties: Is this solicitation intended to award all locations within the district to one service provider or will this be broken up into geographical grouping areas of the school district?

Day Porter Services: At locations that are requesting a day porter service, does the district have a minimum day porter PTE or FTE requirement per locations, and is the quote to be in an hourly rate or a full time rater per month?
Current Service Provider?: Respectfully who is/are the current service provider(s)?
Emergency Services: What has "emergency operations" support meant in practice, type of work and frequency?
Emergency Services Billing: Should emergency operations and special event support be included in the monthly line-item pricing in Exhibit D, or will they be billed separately at hourly rates?

Is Summer 2027 in scope?: Exhibit C §1 requires complete restorative services of all educational facilities each summer. Since the contract start date is July 1, 2027, is the summer 2027 restorative cycle included in the scope of the initial contract term, or will it be completed under the current contract prior to transition?

Completion Deadline: If the summer 2027 restorative cycle is included in the initial contract term, what is the required completion date for restorative work at each facility (for example, prior to teacher work days or prior to the first day of school)?

Access before July 1: Exhibit A §3 provides for a mobilization period of 120 to 180 days prior to contract commencement. Will the successful contractor have access to District facilities during mobilization to conduct floor surveys, stage equipment, and complete site-specific training before July 1, 2027?
Question for Q&A: Please provide the current custodial staffing plan by site, including the number of full-time and part-time positions, shifts, daily hours, day porters, and supervisors or managers.
Question for Q&A: How many service days per year should proposers price for each facility type, and what level of service is expected on non-student days, school breaks and summer?

Summer Occupancy: Will any District facilities be occupied during summer 2027 (for example, summer school, camps, community use, or construction projects) in a way that would limit restorative work schedules? If so, can the District provide a list of affected facilities?
Question for Q&A: Is special event support included in the Exhibit D monthly price or billed separately, and if separately, how should proposers submit event rates?
Current Restoration Status: Can the District share the most recent summer restorative schedule and indicate when hard floor refinishing and carpet extraction were last completed at each facility?
Question for Q&A: Are summer restorative cleaning, annual floor refinishing, carpet extraction and exterior window cleaning to be included in the Exhibit D monthly price?
Question for Q&A: Are the square footages in Exhibit D gross or cleanable

Question for Q&A: For elementary schools where the District provides equipment, are those schools currently cleaned by the contractor or by District employees, and who is responsible for maintaining and replacing that equipment?
Question for Q&A: Does the District require specific management positions, such as a dedicated account manager or zone supervisors, or minimum supervisor-to-staff ratios?
Question for Q&A: Does the District intend to award all sites on Exhibit D to a single supplier?
Question for Q&A: What are the evaluation scoring weights for price and technical categories, and is there a page limit for the technical proposal?

Restorative Work Scope: Exhibit C §1 requires "complete restorative services of all educational facilities to occur each summer." Please define the specific tasks included in summer restorative services, and indicate whether "complete refinishing" of hard floors (Exhibit C §10) requires full stripping and refinishing or may be performed as scrub and recoat.
Gymnasium wood floors: Is refinishing of wood gymnasium floors (sanding and recoating) included in the contractor's scope, or performed by a separate District vendor?
Define educational facilities: Does "educational facilities" in Exhibit C §1 include administrative or support facilities listed in Exhibit D?

Question for Q&A: The RFP states the District generally provides equipment for all elementary schools. Does this also apply to the three preschools (The Cottage, The Journey, The Outback), Challenge School (K-8), and mobile units at elementary sites?

Liability Insurance: MSA Section 15(d) requires Professional Liability Insurance of $3,000,000 per occurrence / $3,000,000+ aggregate. The District's Vendor/Partner Insurance Requirements list this limit for higher-risk licensed professions (e.g., attorneys, accountants, medical professionals). For custodial services, will the District accept Errors & Omissions coverage of $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate (per MSA Section 15(d)(1)) in place of the $3,000,000 Professional Liability requirement?
Renewal year pricing: Will the District consider annual price adjustments for the renewal years (for example, to reflect minimum wage or labor cost changes), and if so, how should they be proposed?

How monthly pricing should be calculated: Exhibit D requests a single monthly price per site. Should the monthly price be a levelized amount (total annual price divided by 12) that accounts for school breaks, summer, and reduced-service periods, or should it reflect a standard school-year month?

Pro-rated payment during closures: MSA Section 7.1.2 provides for pro-rated payment when services are not provided each day of a month. Does this pro-ration apply to days when the District does not require services (such as holidays and school breaks), or only to days when required services are not performed by the contractor?

Separate summer pricing: Staffing requirements during summer restorative work differ from the school year. Will the District accept separate monthly pricing for summer months and school-year months, or must a single monthly price per site apply year-round?
Day porters on non-contact days: Are day porter services listed in Exhibit D required during summer and school breaks, or only on days when schools are in session?

Multiple / Partial Awards: Does the District intend to make a single district-wide award under RFP 27-007, or does the District reserve the right to make multiple or partial awards to different vendors by individual facility, group of facilities, geographic area, or other portion of the scope?
Custodial Question: What work order management system (CMMS) does the District currently use, and what level of integration with that system will be expected from the custodial contractor?

Exhibit A - SUA: Page 28 of the solicitation includes an Exhibit A – SUA Enrollment Form as part of the sample Master Services Agreement. Please confirm whether respondents electing J.P. Morgan’s Single-Use Accounts (SUA) payment option are required to complete and submit this form with their proposal, or whether the form is to be completed only by the awarded supplier after contract award.

COI Submission: The RFP identifies a Certificate of Insurance (COI) as an additional required proposal document, while the Vendor/Partner Insurance Requirements state that the certificate may be emailed or faxed to CCSD Risk Management. Please confirm whether respondents should include the COI with their proposal submission through BidNet only, submit it separately to Risk Management, or provide it through both methods.

Response Format: Exhibit A, Section 6 provides a response format that is to be “combined with Section 5.0 above.” Please clarify whether respondents should organize their technical proposal using the headings listed in Exhibit A, Section 6 (a–h) and incorporate the applicable Section 5.0 requirements within those sections, or whether the District expects respondents to address Sections 5.1–5.6 separately in addition to the Exhibit A response format.

Response Format: Exhibit A, Section 2 identifies six Additional Minimum Qualifications that proposers should demonstrate. Please confirm whether respondents should provide a specific response to each qualification within the technical proposal and, if so, under which section of the required response format the District would like these qualifications addressed.

Additional Documentation/Response Format: Section 5.6 identifies the W-9, HUB certification (if applicable), and Certificate of Insurance (if applicable) as Additional Required Documents. Please clarify whether these documents should be included as attachments or appendices to the technical proposal, or submitted separately through BidNet. If they should be included within the technical proposal, please identify where the District would like them placed within the Exhibit A, Section 6 response format.

Clarification on Key Response Sections: Exhibit A, Section 6 identifies separate required response sections for (e) Quality Assurance Program and Capabilities, (f) Technology and Integration Capabilities, and (g) Safety & Compliance. Please clarify the key information or evaluation criteria the District expects respondents to address within each section, particularly where those requirements are not specifically identified in Section 5.0.

Regarding cleaning of Stadiums: Is there a schedule that the stadiums will be cleaned per season and or per year or is there daily cleaning per the school calendar?
Weekend Support Needs: Is event support, including weekends and community or facility-rental use, included in the monthly Exhibit D price, or billed separately? If billed, at what rate structure?

Community Facility Usage: Can the district share annual event and facility-use volume by site from its CMMS or facility rental system, such as hours of community league use at each high school and middle school?

Cleaning Equipment: The equipment that is provided for the Elementary Schools, are the upright and back pack vacuums included?

Day Porters: The Day Porters that are needed in the designated schools, can you please share what schedules are needed to facilitate this function?

Cleaning Schedule: The regular day to day cleaning, is this just (5) five days a week, Mon - Fri?

Multiple Related Questions: There are different floor types and facility details that significantly change cleaning scope, equipment requirements, and maintenance chemistry: Polished/Sealed Concrete with Stress Cracks: Locker room/corridor concrete floors show visible wear, cracking, and surface staining. Concrete needs auto-scrubbing and periodic densifying/sealing rather than waxing. Standard VCT tiles in classrooms and cafeteria areas. These require traditional finish maintenance (buffing/burnishing and periodic strip/recoat). Patterned carpet tiles in media centers/libraries with movable stacked seating. Requires daily vacuuming and hot-water extraction, plus furniture clearing. High-shine terrazzo in main hallways. This requires neutral pH cleaners, micro-fiber dust mopping, and periodic high-speed diamond pad burnishing, never standard floor wax. Suspended light fixtures with grilles hang below the acoustic drop ceiling. These collect dust on top and inside the housing grids, requiring vacuuming/wiping at height. For the high-gloss terrazzo corridors (shown at Fox Ridge MS), is the contractor required to perform diamond-pad burnishing or crystallization, and will the district specify pH-neutral cleaning chemicals to preserve the sealant? Clarification: For the day-porter lines in Exhibit D, how many hours per day and days per week does each line represent?
